WITH /* isry.itgcm.bizcmmns.cmmns.SrvcResrceClMapper.selectSrvcResrceClList(자원제공서비스분류조회) */ V_CMMNS_DTL AS ( /* 자원제공서비스상세분류 조회 */ SELECT SUBSTR(T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE,1,2) AS LCLAS_VL_CD -- 자원제공서비스대분류구분코드값 , SUBSTR(T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE,1,4) AS MLSFC_VL_CD -- 자원제공서비스중분류구분코드값 , SUBSTR(T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE,1,6) AS SCLAS_VL_CD -- 자원제공서비스소분류구분코드값 , T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS DTL_VL_CD -- 자원제공서비스상세분류구분코드값 FROM SAC000 T21 /* 공통코드 */ , SAC100 T22 /* 공통코드 값 */ WHERE T21.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SRVC_RESRCE_DTL_SE_CD' AND T21.CMMNS_CD_ID = T22.CMMNS_CD_ID (+) ORDER BY T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE ) , V_CMMNS_SCLAS AS ( /* 자원제공서비스소분류 조회 */ SELECT SUBSTR(T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE,1,2) AS LCLAS_VL_CD -- 자원제공서비스대분류구분코드값 , SUBSTR(T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE,1,4) AS MLSFC_VL_CD -- 자원제공서비스중분류구분코드값 , T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS SCLAS_VL_CD -- 자원제공서비스소분류구분코드값 , NULL AS DTL_VL_CD -- 자원제공서비스상세분류구분코드값 FROM SAC000 T21 /* 공통코드 */ , SAC100 T22 /* 공통코드 값 */ WHERE T21.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SRVC_RESRCE_SCLAS_SE_CD' AND T21.CMMNS_CD_ID = T22.CMMNS_CD_ID (+) ORDER BY T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE ) , V_CMMNS_MLSFC AS ( /* 자원제공서비스중분류 조회 */ SELECT SUBSTR(T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE,1,2) AS LCLAS_VL_CD -- 자원제공서비스대분류구분코드값 , T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS MLSFC_VL_CD -- 자원제공서비스중분류구분코드값 , NULL AS SCLAS_VL_CD -- 자원제공서비스소분류구분코드값 , NULL AS DTL_VL_CD -- 자원제공서비스상세분류구분코드값 FROM SAC000 T21 /* 공통코드 */ , SAC100 T22 /* 공통코드 값 */ WHERE T21.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SRVC_RESRCE_MLSFC_SE_CD' AND T21.CMMNS_CD_ID = T22.CMMNS_CD_ID (+) ORDER BY T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE ) , V_CMMNS_LCLAS AS ( /* 자원제공서비스대분류 조회 */ SELECT T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS LCLAS_VL_CD -- 자원제공서비스대분류구분코드값 , NULL AS MLSFC_VL_CD -- 자원제공서비스중분류구분코드값 , NULL AS SCLAS_VL_CD -- 자원제공서비스소분류구분코드값 , NULL AS DTL_VL_CD -- 자원제공서비스상세분류구분코드값 FROM SAC000 T21 /* 공통코드 */ , SAC100 T22 /* 공통코드 값 */ WHERE T21.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND T21.CMMNS_CD_ID = T22.CMMNS_CD_ID (+) ORDER BY T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE ) , V_CMMNS_LIST AS ( SELECT T1.LCLAS_VL_CD AS SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD -- 자원제공서비스대분류구분코드값 , T1.MLSFC_VL_CD AS SRVC_RESRCE_MLSFC_SE_CD -- 자원제공서비스중분류구분코드값 , T1.SCLAS_VL_CD AS SRVC_RESRCE_SCLAS_SE_CD -- 자원제공서비스소분류구분코드값 , T1.DTL_VL_CD AS SRVC_RESRCE_DTL_SE_CD -- 자원제공서비스상세분류구분코드값 , COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY T1.LCLAS_VL_CD) AS LCLAS_VL_CNT , COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY T1.LCLAS_VL_CD, T1.MLSFC_VL_CD) AS MLSFC_VL_CNT , COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY T1.LCLAS_VL_CD, T1.MLSFC_VL_CD, T1.SCLAS_VL_CD) AS SCLAS_VL_CNT FROM ( SELECT T11.LCLAS_VL_CD AS LCLAS_VL_CD , T11.MLSFC_VL_CD AS MLSFC_VL_CD , T11.SCLAS_VL_CD AS SCLAS_VL_CD , T11.DTL_VL_CD AS DTL_VL_CD FROM V_CMMNS_DTL T11 UNION ALL SELECT T11.LCLAS_VL_CD AS LCLAS_VL_CD , T11.MLSFC_VL_CD AS MLSFC_VL_CD , T11.SCLAS_VL_CD AS SCLAS_VL_CD , T11.DTL_VL_CD AS DTL_VL_CD FROM V_CMMNS_SCLAS T11 UNION ALL SELECT T11.LCLAS_VL_CD AS LCLAS_VL_CD , T11.MLSFC_VL_CD AS MLSFC_VL_CD , T11.SCLAS_VL_CD AS SCLAS_VL_CD , T11.DTL_VL_CD AS DTL_VL_CD FROM V_CMMNS_MLSFC T11 UNION ALL SELECT T11.LCLAS_VL_CD AS LCLAS_VL_CD , T11.MLSFC_VL_CD AS MLSFC_VL_CD , T11.SCLAS_VL_CD AS SCLAS_VL_CD , T11.DTL_VL_CD AS DTL_VL_CD FROM V_CMMNS_LCLAS T11 ) T1 WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY T1.LCLAS_VL_CD, T1.MLSFC_VL_CD, T1.SCLAS_VL_CD, T1.DTL_VL_CD ORDER BY T1.LCLAS_VL_CD, T1.MLSFC_VL_CD, T1.SCLAS_VL_CD, T1.DTL_VL_CD ), SRVC_RESRCE_LIST AS ( SELECT T.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD AS SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD -- 자원제공서비스대분류구분코드 , ( SELECT X.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 X WHERE X.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND X.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD ) AS SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_NM , T.SRVC_RESRCE_MLSFC_SE_CD AS SRVC_RESRCE_MLSFC_SE_CD -- 자원제공서비스중분류구분코드 , ( SELECT X.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 X WHERE X.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SRVC_RESRCE_MLSFC_SE_CD' AND X.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T.SRVC_RESRCE_MLSFC_SE_CD ) AS SRVC_RESRCE_MLSFC_SE_NM , T.SRVC_RESRCE_SCLAS_SE_CD AS SRVC_RESRCE_SCLAS_SE_CD -- 자원제공서비스소분류구분코드 , ( SELECT X.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 X WHERE X.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SRVC_RESRCE_SCLAS_SE_CD' AND X.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T.SRVC_RESRCE_SCLAS_SE_CD ) AS SRVC_RESRCE_SCLAS_SE_NM , T.SRVC_RESRCE_DTL_SE_CD AS SRVC_RESRCE_DTL_SE_CD -- 자원제공서비스상세분류구분코드 , ( SELECT X.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 X WHERE X.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SRVC_RESRCE_DTL_SE_CD' AND X.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T.SRVC_RESRCE_DTL_SE_CD ) AS SRVC_RESRCE_DTL_SE_NM FROM V_CMMNS_LIST T WHERE 1 = 1 AND ((T.LCLAS_VL_CNT = 1) OR (T.LCLAS_VL_CNT > 1 AND T.SRVC_RESRCE_MLSFC_SE_CD IS NOT NULL)) AND ((T.MLSFC_VL_CNT = 1) OR (T.MLSFC_VL_CNT > 1 AND T.SRVC_RESRCE_SCLAS_SE_CD IS NOT NULL)) AND ((T.SCLAS_VL_CNT = 1) OR (T.SCLAS_VL_CNT > 1 AND T.SRVC_RESRCE_DTL_SE_CD IS NOT NULL))
AND NVL(T.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD,'X') LIKE #{SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD} || '%'
AND NVL(T.SRVC_RESRCE_MLSFC_SE_CD,'X') LIKE #{SRVC_RESRCE_MLSFC_SE_CD} || '%'
AND NVL(T.SRVC_RESRCE_SCLAS_SE_CD,'X') LIKE #{SRVC_RESRCE_SCLAS_SE_CD} || '%'
AND NVL(T.SRVC_RESRCE_DTL_SE_CD,'X') LIKE #{SRVC_RESRCE_DTL_SE_CD} || '%'
) SELECT T.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD AS SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD , T.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_NM AS SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_NM , T.SRVC_RESRCE_MLSFC_SE_CD AS SRVC_RESRCE_MLSFC_SE_CD , T.SRVC_RESRCE_MLSFC_SE_NM AS SRVC_RESRCE_MLSFC_SE_NM , T.SRVC_RESRCE_SCLAS_SE_CD AS SRVC_RESRCE_SCLAS_SE_CD , T.SRVC_RESRCE_SCLAS_SE_NM AS SRVC_RESRCE_SCLAS_SE_NM , T.SRVC_RESRCE_DTL_SE_CD AS SRVC_RESRCE_DTL_SE_CD , T.SRVC_RESRCE_DTL_SE_NM AS SRVC_RESRCE_DTL_SE_NM FROM SRVC_RESRCE_LIST T WHERE 1 = 1
AND ((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SAC110 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD) = 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SAC110 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD AND UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD})) AND ((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SAC110 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SRVC_RESRCE_MLSFC_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T.SRVC_RESRCE_MLSFC_SE_CD) = 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SAC110 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SRVC_RESRCE_MLSFC_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T.SRVC_RESRCE_MLSFC_SE_CD AND UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD})) AND ((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SAC110 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SRVC_RESRCE_SCLAS_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T.SRVC_RESRCE_SCLAS_SE_CD) = 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SAC110 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SRVC_RESRCE_SCLAS_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T.SRVC_RESRCE_SCLAS_SE_CD AND UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD})) AND ((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SAC110 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SRVC_RESRCE_DTL_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T.SRVC_RESRCE_DTL_SE_CD) = 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SAC110 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SRVC_RESRCE_DTL_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T.SRVC_RESRCE_DTL_SE_CD AND UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD}))
ORDER BY T.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD, T.SRVC_RESRCE_MLSFC_SE_CD, T.SRVC_RESRCE_SCLAS_SE_CD, T.SRVC_RESRCE_DTL_SE_CD
